
## Response scoring and trial reconstruction

```{r}
task2_order <- data %>%
  select(ID, A207_01:A207_21) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -ID,
    names_to = "trial",
    names_prefix = "A207_",
    values_to = "position"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    trial = as.integer(trial),
    position = as.integer(position)
  )
```

```{r}
task2_design <- data %>%
  select(ID, A205_01) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(A205_01, sep = "###") %>%
  filter(A205_01 != "") %>%
  transmute(
    ID,
    trial   = as.integer(get_field(A205_01, "trial")),
    vistype = get_field(A205_01, "vistype"),
    pattern = get_field(A205_01, "pattern"),
    subject = as.integer(get_field(A205_01, "subject")),
    stimulus = get_field(A205_01, "stim"),
    img_url  = get_field(A205_01, "imgUrl"),
    input_id = get_field(A205_01, "inputId")
  )

task2_responses <- data %>%
  select(ID, A201_01:A201_21) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -ID,
    names_to = "input_id",
    values_to = "selected_region"
  )
```


```{r}
score_text <- paste(
  readLines(project_path("regions.txt"), encoding = "UTF-8"),
  collapse = "\n"
)
score_matches <- stringr::str_match_all(
  score_text,
  '"([^"]+)"\\s*=>\\s*array\\(([^)]*)\\)'
)[[1]]
region_scores <- tibble::tibble(
  stimulus = score_matches[, 2],
  values = score_matches[, 3]
) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(values, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  group_by(stimulus) %>%
  mutate(
    region = sprintf("R%02d", row_number()),
    score = as.numeric(values)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(stimulus, region, score)
```

```{r}
task2 <- task2_design %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) %>%
  left_join(task2_responses %>% mutate(ID = as.character(ID)),
            by = c("ID", "input_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    region_number = readr::parse_number(selected_region),
    region = sprintf("R%02d", region_number)
  ) %>%
  left_join(region_scores, by = c("stimulus", "region")) %>%
  left_join(task2_order, by = c("ID", "trial")) %>%
  select(ID, trial, position, vistype, stimulus, region, score)

task2
```




## Descriptive detection scores

```{r}
task2_model <- task2 %>%
  transmute(
    ID = factor(ID),
    stimulus = factor(stimulus),
    vistype = relevel(factor(vistype), ref = "basic"),
    position_c = as.integer(position) - 11,
    score = as.numeric(score)
  ) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))
task2_model
```

```{r}
task2_model[task2_model$stimulus == "MMN_30",]
```

```{r task2-descriptive-summary}
task2_table <- task2_model %>%
  group_by(vistype) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = round(mean(score), 3),
    median = round(median(score), 3),
    sd = round(sd(score), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

task2_table |> arrange(desc(median))
```

```{r task2-descriptive-plot}
task2_table |>
  ggplot(aes(median, reorder(vistype, median))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = "#6BAED6") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = pmax(median - sd, 0),
      xmax = pmin(median + sd, 1)
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", median)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    nudge_y = -0.20,
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    "Median score",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = vistype_labels) +
  labs(title = "Detection task accuracy", y = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 22),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
```

## Detection-score analysis

```{r}
model_task2 <- glmmTMB(
  score ~ vistype + 
    (1 | ID),
  family = ordbeta(link = "logit"),
  data = task2_model
)

summary(model_task2)
```

```{r}
model_task2_no_vistype <- update(
  model_task2,
  . ~ . - vistype
)

anova(model_task2_no_vistype, model_task2)
```

```{r task2-estimates}
task2_estimates <- emmeans(
  model_task2,
  ~ vistype,
  type = "response"
) |>
  confint() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  transmute(
    vistype,
    predicted_score = response,
    lower_ci = asymp.LCL,
    upper_ci = asymp.UCL
  ) |>
  arrange(predicted_score) |>
  mutate(
    vistype = factor(vistype, levels = vistype)
  )

task2_estimates
```
```{r task2-pairwise-comparisons}
emm_task2 <- emmeans(
  model_task2,
  ~ vistype
)

task2_pairs <- pairs(
  emm_task2,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

task2_pairs

task2_pairs |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05)
```
```{r task2-response-scale-comparisons}
emm_task2_response <- regrid(
  emm_task2,
  transform = "response"
)

task2_score_differences <- pairs(
  emm_task2_response,
  adjust = "tukey"
) |>
  confint() |>
  as.data.frame()

task2_score_differences
```


```{r}

detection_score_figure <- ggplot(
  task2_estimates,
  aes(
    x = predicted_score,
    y = vistype
  )
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower_ci,

  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
```

## Completion-time analysis

```{r task2-time-data}
task2_time <- data %>%
  select(ID, TIME029:TIME049) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -ID,
    names_to = "time_var",
    values_to = "time_sec"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    # TIME029:TIME049 correspond to experimental positions 1:21.
    position = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(time_var, "TIME")) - 28L,
    time_sec = readr::parse_double(as.character(time_sec))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    task2 %>%
      transmute(
        ID = as.character(ID),
        position,
        trial,
        vistype
      ),
    by = c("ID", "position")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_sec), !is.na(vistype), time_sec > 0)

task2_time
```

```{r task2-time-summary}
task2_time_table <- task2_time %>%
  remove_group_iqr_outliers(time_sec, vistype) %>%
  group_by(vistype) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_sec = median(time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sec = mean(time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sec = sd(time_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

task2_time_table |> arrange(median_sec)
```

### Model-estimated completion time

```{r task2-time-model}
task2_time_model <- task2_time %>%
  transmute(
    ID = factor(ID),
    vistype = relevel(factor(vistype), ref = "basic"),
    position = as.integer(position),
    time_sec = as.numeric(time_sec)
  ) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.), time_sec > 0) %>%
  mutate(position_c = position - mean(position))

task2_time_fit <- lmer(
  log(time_sec) ~ vistype + position_c + (1 | ID),
  data = task2_time_model
)

task2_time_estimates <- emmeans(
  task2_time_fit,
  ~ vistype,
  type = "response"
) %>%
  confint() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    vistype,
    estimated_time = response,
    lower_ci = lower.CL,
    upper_ci = upper.CL
  ) %>%
  arrange(estimated_time) %>%
  mutate(vistype = factor(vistype, levels = vistype))

task2_time_estimates
```

```{r task2-time-estimate-plot}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(
  task2_time_estimates,
  aes(x = estimated_time, y = vistype)
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f s", estimated_time)),
    nudge_y = 0.36,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5),
    labels = vistype_labels
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f s", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Detection task completion time",
    x = "Model-estimated time (seconds)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Points show back-transformed model estimates.\n",
      "Error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals."
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 16, 12, 16)
  )
```
